purpose: Source-only tar inventory of official immutable OCI layers; never execute, import, mount, or extract image binaries
analysis: Hash compressed body against manifest, hash full decompressed tar against config diff_id, inventory all members/modes/links/whiteouts and regular file hashes without filesystem extraction. Retain only bounded selected text version/package/CA material and inventories. Resolve required paths through final overlay links.
retention: Delete only these owned compressed blobs after successful digest-bound inventory to avoid a large Git payload; retain exact URLs/digests/sizes/inventories/selected text and cleanup record.
limitations: Layer inspection proves source bytes and path metadata only. Actual exec permissions under Docker, shared-library closure, crypto/CA loading, exact tool commands, Hex/Rebar compatibility and both synthetic test results still require reviewed fresh remote execution.
